notes.title: XROOM v2.0.1 Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/45be2f26db2a6b32752605b995c41c5c81664d03.png[/img]
[h1]Major Update[/h1]

[h3]Login and Registration Features Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Asset rewards for registration
[*] Feature restrictions for non-logged-in users
[/list]
Login Screen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/7a8a3d62871bf0674137c366d733959c2af12ec0.png[/img]
Asset Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/440d1c7e9c9eeb7ce80d82178bff723f32176a12.png[/img]

[h3]MediaPlane Changes[/h3]
[b]Added FigureComposite[/b]
[list]
[*] Integration of Composure, XRPlane, and MediaPlane
[/list]
[b]Added Presentation[/b]
[list]
[*] Media sources listed
[*] Media source switching via arrow keys
[/list]
Updated Library and Presentation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/0b07078a97286140c6f1ced7846d8281d1018a67.png[/img]

[h3]MovingScene[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added camera selection feature (1 ~ 4)
[*] Added broadcast window button
[/list]
MovingScene
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/e2b5ebb62d0229c95739c2909264fbb039fd675e.png[/img]

[h3]Broadcasting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a dedicated broadcasting window
[*] Added SDI output settings
[/list]
Dedicated Broadcasting Window
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/04259a5ca0c9c9e178494d9275d9f602d31823c0.png[/img]

[h3]Snap & Align[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Vertex / Edge / Face Snap features
[*] Added Vertical and Horizontal Align features
[/list]
Snap & Align
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683859/f15d249ecfb8b2da8a62d51b9b9f1de9778abc77.png[/img]

Thank you.

notes.title: v2.0.1 Major Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[b][v2.0.1 Major Update Schedule Information]
[/b]Scheduled Release Date: [strike]2/28[/strike]  [strike]3/7[/strike] 3/14

Here’s what’s new:[olist]
[*] Introduction of the transmission function.
[*] Added multi-setting functionality for transmission cameras.
[*] New transmission tutorial included.
[*] Adjustments to font and icon sizes.
[*] Implementation of the login feature.
[*] Improved image quality for the Media Plan.
[/olist]
Stay tuned for the update!

notes.title: XROOM Steam v1.2.5 Upload
notes.content:
[b]Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Added functionality to reorder PPT slots.
[*] Added adjustable properties for PPT objects.
[*] Copy and paste functionality for TransformAttribute.
[*] Redesigned the TransformAttribute modal UI.
[*] Updated camera TransformAttribute modification options.

Resolved issues with applying lights placed in the map.
Adjusted the behavior of the scale gizmo for better control.
